data.item: Global Credit Rating Co. rates Equity Group Equity’s Global Credit Rating September 2017  GCR has affirmed the national scale ratings assigned to Equity Group Holdings Plc of AA-(KE) and A1+(KE) in the long term and short term respectively; with the outlook accorded as Stable.  The accorded ratings assigned to EGH Plc reflects its strong competitive position in Kenya’s banking industry, which is underpinned by a favorable market reputation, as well as a resilient and innovative financial services business, spread across East Africa and the Democratic Republic of Congo.  The rating is also as a result of its Robust internal capital generation and strong Profitability which remained resilient in FY16 despite challenging operating conditions, characterized by economic and political uncertainty and unfavorable banking developments in Kenya.
